story.heading: From welding to code
paragraphs: Before I got into programming, I spent years working in manufacturing, including as a welder. My first app was a to-do list in vanilla JavaScript, and in late 2024 I started learning PHP and Laravel in my spare time.

Since September 2026 I have been working as a developer in e-commerce, improving an online store and building tools for the team. In my spare time I build my own apps, from the database to deployment on my own server.
I am most interested in what is easy to break: business rules, dates, concurrency and session security.
